$comment: ELDRICK as a remote MCP tool for the xAI API (https://docs.x.ai/developers/tools/remote-mcp). Shared by the Python and TypeScript starters and checked offline by server/lib/grok-bot-template.test.ts. The ELDRICK key is never stored here: each starter reads ELDRICK_API_KEY from the environment and adds it as `authorization` at runtime.

tool.server_description: ELDRICK golf club fitting: fits drivers, fairway woods, hybrids, irons and wedges from a golfer's swing, scores and compares real clubs, sizes grips, checks bag gapping and finds club fitters.
